scope: Task 8 metadata discoverer, response archive/verifier, selector integration, safe local paths, and fixed CLI

findings.summary: A repository search item URL was accepted as any syntactically valid URL and could redirect subsequent branch/tree metadata reads outside the fixed GitHub API origin.
findings.resolution: Discoverer and independent verifier require the exact https://api.github.com/repos/{full_name} identity before branch/tree use.

findings.summary: A competing or failed failure.json write could be swallowed while only the original discovery error escaped.
findings.redEvidence: focused RED: competing failure file was not rejected; 13 pass, 2 fail, 41 assertions
findings.resolution: The output directory and failure.json handle are created exclusively before network access; failure data is written through the held handle and synchronized, and any archive error becomes an AggregateError.

findings.summary: Lexical resolve/relative checks allowed protocol reads and discovery writes through a Windows junction outside the repository root.
findings.redEvidence: focused RED: junction-backed protocol resolved and competing failure file remained unreserved; 13 pass, 2 fail, 41 assertions
findings.resolution: Shared path guards normalize repository-relative paths, reject symlink/junction components with lstat, check realpath containment, and exclusively create output paths before requests.

findings.summary: The default fetch transport followed redirects even though only the initial request URL was identity-bound.
findings.redEvidence: missing-export RED for redirect and response-metadata tests: 0 pass, 1 fail, 1 error
findings.resolution: The public metadata transport is explicit and uses redirect=error.

findings.summary: Only response bodies were archived, so content type and rate-limit summary fields could not be independently reconstructed.
findings.redEvidence: missing-export RED for redirect and response-metadata tests: 0 pass, 1 fail, 1 error
findings.resolution: Every successful response now has a digest-bound metadata sidecar containing status, content-type, and exact rate-limit strings; the verifier rereads it and reconstructs summary fields.

findings.summary: The 64 MiB guard was checked only after arrayBuffer had already consumed the response.
findings.redEvidence: read-only source review of the pre-fix transport
findings.resolution: The default transport now reads the response stream incrementally, cancels above 64 MiB, and retains the postcondition check for injected transports.

findings.summary: The verifier compared the report and raw incomplete_results values but did not independently require the value to be false.
findings.redEvidence: coordinated report/body tamper RED: 15 pass, 1 fail, 47 assertions; verifier resolved instead of rejecting
findings.resolution: The independent verifier now directly rejects every archived search response with incomplete_results=true before reconstructing repository identities.

findings.summary: The verifier rebound rate-limit fields but did not enforce that every nonterminal request left capacity for the next fixed request; the discoverer also omitted the final-search-to-branch and branch-to-tree boundaries.
findings.redEvidence: coordinated sidecar/report tamper RED: 15 pass, 1 fail, 48 assertions; verifier resolved with a nonterminal remaining value of zero
findings.resolution: Discoverer and verifier now enforce the full search-page to repository-branch to recursive-tree request sequence, permitting zero remaining only after the terminal request.

knownLimitation: The controlled single-process path contract rejects existing symlink/junction components but does not claim hostile concurrent TOCTOU resistance between checks and ordinary path opens.

finalReview.scope: post-fix fixed request sequence, independent replay, response metadata, failure archive, and path boundary
